title: Shipping Method, Shipping Charges and Billing Route of Wound Care Refills
content:
# Shipping and billing of refills — Wound Care Supply Program

Terms on which Wound Care Supply Program refills are shipped and billed.

## Terms

- **Standard ground shipping.** Standard ground shipping is free on insured tiers. On the Wound Care Self-Pay Program standard shipping costs the tier's standard ground shipping fee, posted as a patient charge, unless the shipment's cash-price total reaches the free-shipping threshold.
- **Expedited shipping.** Expedited shipping is provided on the customer's request for the expedited shipping fee, posted as a patient charge because no payer covers delivery speed, and is recorded as expedited at no charge when the expedite only makes up for a delay Larkfield caused.
- **Billing route.** A refill on a payer tier is billed to the payer by claim with the ship date as the date of service; a refill on the Wound Care Self-Pay Program is charged to the customer at the Larkfield cash price.

## Shipping method and charge

| Tier | Shipping method | Charge to the customer |
|---|---|---|
| Insured tier | standard ground | none |
| Wound Care Self-Pay Program | standard ground, cash-price total at or above the threshold | none |
| Wound Care Self-Pay Program | standard ground, cash-price total below the threshold | the standard ground shipping fee |
| Any tier | expedited at the customer's request | the expedited shipping fee |
| Any tier | expedited only to make up a delay Larkfield caused | none — recorded as expedited at no charge |

## Worked charges (hypothetical shipments, using the tariff figures)

1. A self-pay refill of 30 dressings of item A6196 at USD 6.45 each has a cash-price total of USD 193.50, which reaches the USD 75.00 threshold: the customer is charged USD 193.50 at the cash price and nothing for standard shipping.
2. A self-pay refill of 12 dressings of item A6209 at USD 5.90 each has a cash-price total of USD 70.80, below USD 75.00: the customer is charged USD 70.80 at the cash price and the USD 6.95 standard shipping fee.
3. A refill on the Wound Care Commercial PPO Program sent expedited at the customer's request is billed to the payer by claim, and the USD 24.50 expedited fee is posted to the customer as a patient charge.
4. The same refill sent expedited only because Larkfield delayed it is recorded as expedited at no charge, and no expedited fee is posted.
